thread:
incident-bot: PAGE: P1 - newport-prod privnet: widespread 5xx from model API behind NLB/ALB. Affects tenant 'newport' on dedicated pool. Pager: @ava_oncall. Bridge: https://bridge.company/INC-5412
ava_oncall: Oncall here, joining bridge and starting incident checklist. Can someone post quick customer impact?
sam_neteng: I'm on infra. Seeing ALB target churn in newport-subnet-a. Backend gw-privnet-01 conntrack near capacity, many `SYN_RECV` entries. Pulling `conntrack -L | wc -l` and logs now.
maria_sre: Are these dedicated hosts or shared? We need to know blast radius.
lee_support: CSM Jordan reports customer sees ~50% failures since 09:12 UTC, impacting live inference traffic. They want ETA, are you paged @ava_oncall?
ava_oncall: Yes. Verified dedicated pool for tenant. Sam, confirm conntrack counters and any recent config changes.
sam_neteng: `conntrack` count: 1,048,192 / table size 1,200,000 (~87%). Also found an infra job applied SG tighten at 09:05 (PR #2849) — egress rules narrowed to specific CIDRs. Could be amplifying NAT/connections sticky behavior.
ops_lead: If conntrack exhaustion, fastest mitigation is route newport to fresh gateway (gw-privnet-02) and adjust NLB target group. I'll trigger a canary cutover. Also recommend temporary relax SG egress to 10.0.0.0/8 while we validate.
jordan_csm: Customer ok with temporary reroute if it restores traffic quickly. They asked for minimal change and rollback plan.
ava_oncall: I'll coordinate cutover. Sam, are gw-privnet-02 healthchecks green?
sam_neteng: Pushing route update now. Adding gw-privnet-02 to target group. Healthchecks passing on gw-privnet-02 (3/3). Starting traffic shift (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
lee_support: Watching customer metrics... 5xx rate dropping 48% -> 7% as we shift traffic. Customer reports improvement. :thumbsup:
maria_sre: Good. Capture logs and config diffs. We'll need a follow-up: root cause likely conntrack exhaustion triggered by healthcheck spike + SG tightening. Assigning postmortem owners.
ops_lead: Opening ticket INC-2026-5412. Action items: increase conntrack table on gateways, add healthcheck rate-limiting, review SG rollout process for privnet. @sam_neteng and @ops_lead to own remediation.
ava_oncall: Marking incident status: mitigated -> partial. Monitoring for 15m before close. Leaving bridge open.
incident-bot: ACK: page acknowledged at 09:29 UTC by ava_oncall. Automated follow-up scheduled.
ava_oncall: Thanks team. Customer confirmed service restored. Will update customer note and hand off to ops for durable fix and postmortem
